Usage: headroom login [<command>] [flags]
   or: headroom login [<account> ...] [flags]

Renew the Claude Code logins that end soon.

Renews Claude Code logins: one claude auth login per account, in turn, its approval page
opened in the Chrome profile matched to the account's email, or the default browser when
none matches. Bare, it renews each login that ends within --within days, has ended, or was
never made; names renew exactly those, and --all every account, so their logins end
together.

It prints the plan first — every account's login end and where each chosen one's page
opens (all --dry-run prints) — then reads each credential back after its login: ✓ with the
new end, or ✗ when nothing changed or the dir is now logged in as another email. It ends on
the earliest end among the logins renewed, and on a headroom login command naming the ones
that did not take, if any; then it exits 1.

Over ssh from another machine nothing opens here: open the printed URL where you are, in a
browser signed in as the account, and paste the code it shows. An ssh session cannot read
the login Keychain until security unlock-keychain runs in it; accounts whose login lives
there are left alone and named.

For an approver elsewhere — an agent with shell access, which cannot keep a terminal open —
start and finish renew one account's login in two commands that each return: start prints
the sign-in URL as JSON and leaves a holder waiting for the code; finish sends it the
code#state the page showed, read from stdin, and prints whether the login took. status and
cancel inspect and end the sign-in. Nothing opens on this machine. The contract is
docs/specs/login-handoff.md.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --version        Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and exit.

Arguments and flags of renew, the default command:
  <account> ...        The accounts to renew, by email or dir name; bare, the ones that end soon
                       (optional).
      --all            Renew every account's login, so they end together.
      --within=DAYS    Renew the logins that end within this many days (default: 7).
      --dry-run        Print the plan and renew nothing.
      --json           With --dry-run, print the plan as JSON.

Commands:
  renew [<account> ...]    Renew the logins that end soon, or the named ones, one after another at
                           this terminal (default).
  start <account>          Start one account's sign-in for an approver elsewhere, and print its URL
                           as JSON.
  finish <account>         Send a started sign-in the code its page showed, from stdin, and print
                           the verdict as JSON.
  status <account>         Print one account's started sign-in as JSON.
  cancel <account>         End one account's started sign-in while it waits for its code.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why

Run "headroom login <command> --help" for a command's details.
